name: aurelia-motors
description: Aurelia Motors — car dealership platform for Lucknow

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev --workspace @aurelia/api" "npm run dev --workspace @aurelia/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @aurelia/api && npm run build --workspace @aurelia/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @aurelia/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @aurelia/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @aurelia/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace @aurelia/shared && npm run test --workspace @aurelia/api
